summary.intent: Add all missing data to the summary TUI detail pane, which currently shows only a subset of available session data (missing scores, token breakdown, files touched, tool counts, implementation rationale, tradeoffs, codebase patterns, and facet evidence fields).
summary.outcome: Brainstormed and agreed on a compact grouped layout (4 boxes: SUMMARY, CODE, LEARNINGS, SIGNALS), wrote a spec and implementation plan, and began subagent-driven execution through Task 3 (renderCodeBox).

repo: Facets are structured signals extracted from session transcripts via LLM: repeated user instructions, missing context signals, failure loops, skill signals, review-derived rules, repo gotchas, workflow gaps.

Backfilling means sessions start with has_facets=0; entire improve/insights/memory-loop finds uncached sessions, condenses transcripts, calls LLM for extraction, writes to facet tables, sets has_facets=1.

insights.db has 16 tables; key ones: sessions (2633 rows), tool_calls (16029), files_touched (10788), learnings (2269), friction (616), codebase_patterns (422), implementation_rationale (333), tradeoffs (248), review_rule_signals (212), missing_context_signals (189), repeated_user_instructions (103), failure_loops (102), skill_signals (55).
The SIGNALS box friction sub-section must be gated on HasSummary to match existing behavior.
Empty sub-sections and empty boxes are omitted entirely in the new layout.
SUMMARY box omission rule: omit only if HasSummary is false AND OverallScore is 0 AND all stats are zero; renderSummaryBox handles this by returning empty string when no lines generated.

code.finding: Currently renders: SESSION box, TOKENS box, SUMMARY box (intent/outcome), FRICTION box, LEARNINGS box, INSIGHTS box (all facets lumped). Missing: token breakdown, scores, stats, files touched, tool counts, implementation rationale, tradeoffs, codebase patterns, facet evidence fields.
Contains all facet struct types with evidence fields; ReviewRuleSignal has Evidence, SourceKind, Strength, WhyReusable; SkillSignal has Friction and MissingInstruction.
Has sampleRowsForTest helper used as test fixture base; needs updating with new fields.

workflow: Codex companion adversarial review fails with ENOBUFS on large repos — the git diff output exceeds its internal buffer.
Subagent-driven development dispatches one fresh subagent per plan task with review gates between tasks.
Brainstorming skill supports a visual browser-based companion at localhost:65000 for TUI layout mockups.

friction: Codex adversarial review companion hit ENOBUFS buffer overflow on both foreground and background runs — repo git diff is too large for the script's internal buffer; review was skipped entirely.
Visual companion server required a separate URL to open and was described as token-intensive.
open_items: Tasks 3-6 of the implementation plan are incomplete: renderCodeBox (Task 3), renderSignalsBox (Task 4), wiring up new boxes and removing old functions (Task 5), and fmt/lint/test:ci verification (Task 6).
Spec and plan are written but the feature is not yet merged or tested end-to-end.
